name: Cesanese di Olevano Romano
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Lazio denomination limited to the communes of Genazzano and Olevano Romano. Its rules allow still and semi-sparkling wine, from at least 85% of the red Cesanese Comune and Cesanese d'Affile.
